scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir site run check
scripts.build: pnpm run validate && pnpm run test && pnpm run site:build
scripts.validate: pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run lint:workflows
scripts.sample: tsx scripts/ops/seed-sample-source.ts && pnpm run manifest && pnpm run segment && MOCK_TRANSLATION=1 pnpm run queue && MOCK_TRANSLATION=1 pnpm run translate && pnpm tsx scripts/translate/apply-results.ts && pnpm run render && pnpm run site:content
scripts.site:content: tsx scripts/site/build-site-content.ts && tsx scripts/site/build-search-index.ts && tsx scripts/site/build-status-data.ts
scripts.site:build: pnpm run site:content && pnpm --dir site run build
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run site:content && pnpm --dir site run dev --host 127.0.0.1
